learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about fun pairs of words that mean completely different things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Opposite words are word pairs that mean exactly the different thing from each other. They are like two sides of a coin!
When the sun is out it is Day. When the moon is out it is Night. Day and Night are opposite words.
An elephant is very big but a little mouse is small. Big and small are also opposites.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Opposite Game
fun_activity.instructions: When your mom says Stand you sit down! When she says Cry you laugh loudly! Play this funny opposite game.

quick_recap: ⭐ Opposite words mean completely different things.
⭐ Day and night are opposite words.
⭐ Up and down are also opposite words.
